observation.label: 5-Methyltetrahydrofolate

observation.source_reference: Wang, Riedl and Schwartz (2010), Journal of Chromatography B 878(29), 2949–2958, Table 5
observation.source_note: Calculated from the reported Table 5 molar sum, not directly reported mass concentration. observation.label: Inulin
observation.evidence_material: Green asparagus edible spear, var. Herkolim
observation.preparation_state: Lyophilized edible spear; hot-water extract. Root excluded.
observation.notes: Dry matter. Edible spear only. Not converted to fresh weight. Not oligofructose, FOS, or GOS.
observation.source_note: Redondo-Cuenca et al. 2023, Table of non-digestible components: edible-spear inulin 1.30 g/100 g dry matter; DP4 and DP3 were 0 in the edible spear and were measured in the root only (DP4 0.97, DP3 1.01 g/100 g dry matter). Root inulin was 16.18 g/100 g dry matter and is not this record. Goñi et al. 2024 reported about 1.48–1.52 g/100 g dry weight in edible spear and is not averaged into this value. USDA SR Legacy fibre is not this analyte.
